newsitem.title: USA: Sonat names Moylan Jr as financial chief.
newsitem.headline: Sonat names Moylan Jr as financial chief.

text.p: Sonat Inc said it has named James Moylan as chief financial officer of the company and as president of its Sonat Services Inc unit.
The company's chief financial officer position had been vacant for some time, according to a Sonat spokeswoman.
Sonat also said that James Rubright will become president of its Southern Natural Gas Co and head of Sonat Pipeline Group. Moylan is currently president at Southern Natural Gas.
Rubright will also continue as a senior vice president of the parent company, Sonat said.
